in_marathi.name: Sharikaant
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharikaant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess Sharikaant is a manifestation of Lakshmi, the Hindu goddess of wealth, prosperity, fortune, and the consort of Vishnu. The name Sharikaant is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Shri' meaning prosperity and 'Kaant' meaning desirous, indicating a deep desire for prosperity and wealth.
